tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Ворон наздогнав королівський загін. Мейстер Лювін пише тобі про страшну ніч у Вінтерфеллі. Ти читаєш лист і розумієш, що лорд Нед має дізнатися все якомога швидше, але лист можуть перехопити Ланністери.
tasks.q_pl: Kruk dogonił królewski orszak. Maester Luwin pisze do ciebie o strasznej nocy w Winterfell. Czytasz list i rozumiesz, że lord Ned musi dowiedzieć się wszystkiego jak najszybciej, ale list mogą przechwycić Lannisterowie.
tasks.q_en: A raven has caught up with the royal party. Maester Luwin writes to you about a terrible night in Winterfell. As you read, you realise Lord Ned must know everything as soon as possible, but the Lannisters might intercept the letter.

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Must and have to express obligation: Catelyn must warn Ned. Everyone had to run (past = had to). Should and ought to give advice: You should rest. Mustn't means it is forbidden: You mustn't leave Bran alone. Don't have to means it isn't necessary: You don't have to come with me. Should have + past participle criticises the past: Nobody should have left him alone.
tasks.q_pl: Must and have to express obligation: Catelyn must warn Ned. Everyone had to run (past = had to). Should and ought to give advice: You should rest. Mustn't means it is forbidden: You mustn't leave Bran alone. Don't have to means it isn't necessary: You don't have to come with me. Should have + past participle criticises the past: Nobody should have left him alone.
tasks.q_en: Must and have to express obligation: Catelyn must warn Ned. Everyone had to run (past = had to). Should and ought to give advice: You should rest. Mustn't means it is forbidden: You mustn't leave Bran alone. Don't have to means it isn't necessary: You don't have to come with me. Should have + past participle criticises the past: Nobody should have left him alone.

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Нед кидає лист у вогонь і довго мовчить. «Ти вчинив правильно, — нарешті каже він. — З цього дня ми двоє бережемо одну таємницю». Сер Джеймі нічого не почув.
end_good.text_pl: Ned wrzuca list do ognia i długo milczy. „Postąpiłeś słusznie — mówi w końcu. — Od dziś we dwóch strzeżemy jednej tajemnicy”. Ser Jaime niczego nie usłyszał.
end_good.text_en: Ned throws the letter into the fire and says nothing for a long time. “You did the right thing,” he says at last. “From today the two of us keep one secret.” Ser Jaime heard nothing.
